text: Darma cannot accept why his fiancée Rose killed herself, unaware that the couple [carried home a small jar washed up on the beach|trigger|bringing something home], freeing a spirit an imam had cast into the sea. Searching for the truth with Rose's twin sister Seri, he takes the jar with him and returns to his village to rest. There his senile grandmother, the only one who can see the ghost, [invites it into the house|rules|it must be let in], and it [settles on the grieving man|who_suffers|the grieving].
